name: trust-gate-mcp
description: Post-quantum, tamper-evident receipts for consequential agent actions. Every gated decision produces a receipt you can verify offline, from the certificate alone — no server to trust, no database to query.

OAO_RECEIPT_KEY.description: Path to the persistent Ed25519 signing key. Strongly recommended in production: without a stable path the key is regenerated per restart, which breaks verification of every previously minted receipt. Bootstrap refuses to start if the key's kid drifts.

TRUST_GATE_REQUIRE_PQ.description: Require at least one verified post-quantum signature leg on verify. Default ON — defeats signature-stripping downgrade attacks. Set false only to verify legacy Ed25519-only receipts.

TRUST_GATE_BEARER_TOKEN.description: If set, the HTTP transport requires this bearer token. Unset means no auth, which is fine for stdio/local use and not for a public HTTP deployment.

TRUST_GATE_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated CORS allowlist for the HTTP transport. Never use a wildcard.

tools.name: mint_receipt_for_record_change
tools.description: Mint a post-quantum receipt for one CRM record change. Old/new values are SHA-256 hashed, never stored in the clear.

arguments.record_type: The kind of record changed (e.g. contact, deal)

tools.name: audit_my_agent_inventory
tools.description: Rank a CALLER-PROVIDED list of MCP tools by worst-regret if they act. Read-only: mints no receipt. Cannot auto-discover other servers — the MCP protocol does not permit that.

arguments.inventory: List of {server, tool, capability} entries supplied by the caller

tools.name: mint_action_receipt
tools.description: Mint a post-quantum receipt for any consequential agent action, with optional signed attestation provenance (who or what triggered it, and which model decided).

arguments.decision_model: Optional: the LLM model behind the decision

tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Verify a receipt from the certificate alone — offline, no database, no network. Defaults to PQ-required mode.

tools.name: gate_decision
tools.description: Two-phase decision gate. PREVIEW returns a risk assessment and preview_id without acting; COMMIT verifies the inputs still match and mints a tamper-evident receipt carrying an execution permit.

arguments.preview_id: Required on COMMIT — ties the commit to its preview

tools.name: check_egress
tools.description: Classify a data sample as PUBLIC / INTERNAL / CONFIDENTIAL / RESTRICTED before it leaves. Blocks RESTRICTED. Returns classification, retention info, and a receipt.

tools.name: run_exit_drill
tools.description: Vendor exit-readiness drill: checks local signing key, local model access, and local data export. Informational, no side effects.

security.auditTrail: Every minted receipt is hybrid-signed (Ed25519 + ML-DSA-65; plus SLH-DSA when liboqs is installed) and carries a 128-bit kid, so a verifier can confirm offline that two receipts came from the same notary. Verification needs no server and no database — the certificate stands on its own.

novel_capabilities: Post-quantum agent-action receipts (hybrid classical + lattice, optional hash-based leg)
Offline verification from the certificate alone — no server trust, no database lookup
Two-phase PREVIEW to COMMIT gate that binds a decision to the inputs it was assessed on
